findings.CAUSAL_IMPACT: The min() selects an anchor built from raw conviction, single-candle volatility, entropy, and default costs; it can turn core-positive EV into negative adjusted EV and FLAT.
findings.MINIMUM_CORRECTION: Under a separate behavior-change order, select one instrument-bound EV formula or fully reconcile/serialize the anchor terms.
findings.REGRESSION_GATE: Assert no unexplained residual and no alternate branch with undocumented probability/cost semantics.
findings.STATISTICAL_IMPACT: Observed directional coverage is materially changed by an unsupported alternate model.
findings.TITLE: A hidden, semantically different market-EV branch dominates abstention
findings.WHY_EXISTING_TESTS_MISSED_IT: Tests assert market EV does not exceed model EV but do not reconcile the two incompatible formulas or serialize the bridge.

findings.CAUSAL_IMPACT: Distinct risk models are serialized as if one numeric field explained the human reason.
findings.MINIMUM_CORRECTION: Serialize both named ruin probabilities and generate reason from the matching field.

findings.STATISTICAL_IMPACT: The 50% value is an insufficient-data prior, not the core ruin estimate.
findings.TITLE: Persisted risk state says ruin_prob=0 while its human reason says HIGH_RUIN_PROB=50%
findings.WHY_EXISTING_TESTS_MISSED_IT: No invariant binds reason text to a named machine field.

findings.CAUSAL_IMPACT: A direct/UI/workflow/app write to main can become a Northflank deployment without the intended audit gate.

paths: force push unless separately denied at actor/repository level
GitHub UI edit committing to main
manual oracle.yml workflow_dispatch with contents:write and git push
bot/app repository-content write followed by automatic Northflank build

findings.MINIMUM_CORRECTION: Apply the exact guardrails listed in governance evidence.
findings.REGRESSION_GATE: Protected main + required checks + no contents-write direct-push workflow.
findings.STATISTICAL_IMPACT: Unaudited code/evidence can replace the reviewed lineage.
findings.TITLE: Unprotected main plus automatic Northflank CD permits unaudited repository-write-to-production paths
findings.WHY_EXISTING_TESTS_MISSED_IT: CI checks code, not repository settings or auto-CD trust boundaries.

findings.CAUSAL_IMPACT: Exact weights/actions can be replayed from IDs, but the hashed evidence snapshot cannot be independently reconstructed.

findings.CAUSAL_IMPACT: Fixed defaults and mixed spot/swap semantics can bind EV without matching an executable paper instrument.

EVIDENCE.fallback_behavior: fixed anchor slippage and default depth silently bind
EVIDENCE.market_vs_limit_assumption: contradictory: maker fee claim with modeled slippage and unspecified fill style
EVIDENCE.minimum_correction: Choose and document one paper instrument; bind primary-source fee/depth provenance; serialize every anchor term; remove or reconcile the competing EV branch under a separately authorized behavior-change order.
EVIDENCE.observed_inputs: OKX spot ticker/OHLCV/orderbook plus OKX USDT-swap funding/OI

slippage.core: max(1bp, half observed spot spread) then doubled round-trip
slippage.refresh: per decision for core; never for anchor default

findings.MINIMUM_CORRECTION: Instrument-bind fees, spread, slippage, and depth in a separately authorized order.
findings.REGRESSION_GATE: Cost provenance and unit contract fixture.
findings.STATISTICAL_IMPACT: EV labels cannot be interpreted as instrument-realized expectancy.
findings.TITLE: The paper cost model has no single executable instrument or primary fee/depth provenance
findings.WHY_EXISTING_TESTS_MISSED_IT: Unit tests validate arithmetic monotonicity, not primary-source parameter provenance.

findings.CAUSAL_IMPACT: A displayed or reported '96% UP' can be mistaken for P(correct), though it is sigmoid(total_pressure*5).
findings.MINIMUM_CORRECTION: Rename to heuristic_up_score/down_score or attach explicit semantics at every API/UI boundary.
findings.STATISTICAL_IMPACT: No OOS calibration supports probability interpretation.
findings.TITLE: up_prob/down_prob are probability-like names for an uncalibrated heuristic transform
findings.WHY_EXISTING_TESTS_MISSED_IT: Confidence is labeled, but up_prob/down_prob are not.

findings.CAUSAL_IMPACT: The same 10/11 independent rows affect pressures/EV through weights and size through calibration; score authority remains insufficient.
findings.MINIMUM_CORRECTION: Prospectively preregister learning authority and separate/justify the calibration cohort before changing behavior.
findings.REGRESSION_GATE: Learning-authority contract and independent cohort accounting.
findings.SAFETY_IMPACT: Bounded +/-25% and PAPER-only; no live activation.
findings.STATISTICAL_IMPACT: No independent evidence justifies treating N=10/11 as production-learning authority.
findings.TITLE: Small-N evidence mutates weights and also feeds size calibration before score authority exists
findings.WHY_EXISTING_TESTS_MISSED_IT: Tests enforce the configured N=10 and drift bound but do not compare it with reporting authority or double-use.

findings.CAUSAL_IMPACT: The decision remains FLAT, but its machine/human reason falsely states negative EV instead of positive EV below the configured threshold.
findings.MINIMUM_CORRECTION: Serialize adjusted_ev and dynamic_min_ev under an ev_below_dynamic_min reason without changing the gate.
findings.REGRESSION_GATE: Reason sign/threshold coherence plus decision-invariance fixture.
findings.SAFETY_IMPACT: Incorrect operator diagnosis can motivate the wrong remediation.
findings.STATISTICAL_IMPACT: Sign and threshold failure are conflated in abstention attribution.
findings.TITLE: The persisted negative_ev reason mislabels positive EV that only fails the dynamic minimum
findings.WHY_EXISTING_TESTS_MISSED_IT: Tests asserted HOLD behavior but not reason-to-numeric-field coherence.

findings.CAUSAL_IMPACT: A snapshot observed inside the same 5m market window is compared with that market's own settlement while SENEX targets 1h; it cannot establish incremental edge.
findings.MINIMUM_CORRECTION: Fail closed as NOT_ESTIMABLE and call the metric same-market resolved-label agreement.
findings.REGRESSION_GATE: No external accuracy/value-add claim without aligned OOS labels and exact observation times.
findings.SAFETY_IMPACT: Could otherwise be used to justify prohibited directional activation.
findings.STATISTICAL_IMPACT: No causally aligned OOS label, exact snapshot timestamp, independent sampling policy, or preregistered blend exists.
findings.TITLE: The 5m Polymarket resolved-label agreement is not a causal predictive-accuracy or value-add estimate
findings.WHY_EXISTING_TESTS_MISSED_IT: The first harness named the descriptive agreement metric directional_accuracy despite caveats.
